post.summary: Upload the baseline photo once; every job reuses it
post.description: Multipart field `image` (JPEG/PNG/WebP; HEIC is rejected with details.hint='heic'). Downsize to long side ≤ 1600 and ≤ 1.5 MB first. The server normalises to JPEG, long side 1024, EXIF stripped, and uploads to YouCam (free). baselineId = sha256 of the normalised bytes. 201 for a new baseline, 200 when reused. Kept 24 h.

delete.summary: Forget a baseline and its jobs on our side (idempotent)

200.description: Deleted. YouCam keeps its copy up to 30 days.

post.description: Idempotent: the same baseline + spec returns the existing job (200) unless it failed; the same clientRequestId returns that request's job. Use a new clientRequestId for a retry after failure. Units are reserved on create and refunded when the job fails (YouCam errors are free).

get.summary: Poll a job; wait job.retryAfterMs between polls
get.description: Job ids are unguessable capability tokens (96-bit), so a job can be resumed even if the session cookie was lost. Polls within 4 s of the last check are answered from the server's cache; retryAfterMs is 2 s, 4 s after 30 s, 6 s when the YouCam call budget is exhausted. Jobs fail with YOUCAM_TIMEOUT after 180 s.

post.summary: (P1) Create an expiring share link for chosen results
post.description: Multipart: `meta` (JSON, CreateShareMeta, with `consent: true`) and `images` (one file per item, same order, ≤ 2 MB each, ≤ 4.4 MB total). Images are re-encoded to JPEG (≤ 1024 px, metadata stripped) and stored privately until the link expires or is revoked. 5 creates per hour per session. 403 FEATURE_DISABLED when shares are off (status.capabilities.shares).

post.description: Verified with webhook-id / webhook-timestamp / webhook-signature (HMAC-SHA256, YOUCAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET, 5 min tolerance) and deduped by webhook-id. Treated as a nudge: only the task id is read from the body, and the job is advanced by asking YouCam (same path and lock as polling). 404 when no secret is configured.
